description: Returns the cmbs.news distress index: delinquency, special-servicing and matured-unpaid rates (balance-weighted, every trust that files a loan-level tape; the headline view adds this month with the older trusts read from their 10-D reports), this month's transfers in and out of special servicing, and rates by property type. Set view for one part, or for more: vintage, state, series (every month since December 2016) or seasoning. Open data under CC BY 4.0. Use it for market-wide rates and trends; use wire for the individual loans that changed this month.

view.description: Which part of the index to return. Leave out for the latest rates, this month's flows and rates by property type. vintage also has type by vintage; series is the monthly history; seasoning is how the age of the pool moves the rates

name: distress_index

RateCell.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.

balance.description: Sum of current balances of the cell's loans, whole dollars.

dlqRate.description: Share of the cell's balance that is delinquent (30+ days or non-performing matured balloon), a fraction of 1 (0.0418 is 4.18%).

loans.description: Count of loans in the cell (outstanding, not defeased, from trusts that file loan-level data).

maturedRate.description: Share of the cell's balance that is a non-performing matured balloon (part of dlqRate), a fraction of 1.

ssRate.description: Share of the cell's balance with the special servicer, a fraction of 1.

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation distressIndex). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: End date of the latest reporting period in the filings behind the index build, YYYY-MM-DD. (openapi.json.ts calls it the date the index was built; the code sets it to the latest period end.)

backHistory.description: How the series' older and newer months were built and how closely the two methods agree.

agreeWithin.description: Largest gap in any rate between the two methods over the months both cover, as a fraction of 1 (0.00063 is 6.3 basis points).

currentFrom.description: First month built from the latest 12 months of filings, YYYY-MM; months before it come from every report each trust has filed.

since.description: First month of the series, YYYY-MM.

additionalProperties.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.

byState.description: The current month by state, keyed by two-letter code (territories and DC included); loans with no single state are left out.

additionalProperties.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.

byType.description: The current month by property type, keyed by type slug.

byTypeMonthly.description: Address of the open CSV with the index by property type for every month (not data inline).

byTypeVintage.description: The current month by property type and then origination year (2012 on); a type-year with no loans is left out.

additionalProperties.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.

byVintage.description: The current month by origination year, keyed by four-digit year, 2012 on.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

csv.description: Address of the open CSV of the monthly series.

excludes.description: Plain-English statement of what the current breakdowns leave out (defeased loans) and what the series counts.

flows.description: This month's moves in and out of special servicing: The Wire's counts from the live loans (the build's own counts if The Wire cannot be read).

month.description: Month of The Wire issue the counts come from, YYYY-MM. Absent when the build's counts stand in.

returns.description: Count of loans returned from the special servicer to the master servicer this month.

returnsBal.description: Sum of those loans' balances, in dollars.

transfersIn.description: Count of loans newly transferred to the special servicer this month.

transfersInBal.description: Sum of those loans' balances, in dollars.

headline.description: The index for its latest month: every loan record the trusts that file loan-level data (ABS-EE) filed.

balance.description: Dollars: the outstanding balance of the loans counted.

dlqRate.description: Share of balance 30+ days delinquent or matured and not paid off, a fraction of 1 (0.0418 is 4.18%).

loans.description: Loan records filed for the index month, defeased loans included: a count of records, not of loans.

maturedRate.description: Share of balance matured and not paid off (part of dlqRate), a fraction of 1.

ssRate.description: Share of balance with the special servicer, a fraction of 1.

trusts.description: Trusts that filed loan-level data (ABS-EE) for the month.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

method.description: Plain-English definitions: balance-weighted rates, what delinquent and special servicing mean, and which loans each section counts.

otherViews.description: Names of the views not in this answer; method, excludes and suppression come with every view.

seasoning.description: Why early months are not comparable with later ones: the first filers were new deals with young loans.

ageNote.description: Sentence comparing young and older loans' delinquency, with percents written out; empty string when young loans do not run below older ones.

avgAgeAtStart.description: Average loan age in months in the from month.

avgAgeLatest.description: Average loan age in months in the latest month that has one.

byLoanAge.description: Delinquency and special servicing by loan age, pooled over the 12 most recent complete months.

from.description: First month the balance-weighted average loan was at least minAvgAgeMonths old, YYYY-MM; comparisons with past months should start here.

minAvgAgeMonths.description: The threshold for from, in months (24).

note.description: Plain-English caution on comparing months before from, followed by ageNote.

under24ShareAtStart.description: Share of the index's balance (with a known origination date) on loans under 24 months old in the from month, a fraction of 1.

under24ShareLatest.description: The same share in avgAgeLatestMonth, a fraction of 1.

series.description: The index month by month from December 2016, oldest first.

avgAge.description: Balance-weighted average months since origination of the month's loans, to one decimal.

balance.description: Sum of those records' balances, whole dollars.

dlqRate.description: Share of that balance 30+ days delinquent or matured unpaid (payment status 1, 2, 3 or 5), a fraction of 1.

loans.description: Count of loan records filed for the month with a balance above zero (records, not loans: one loan can have several, and defeased loans are in).

maturedRate.description: Share of balance that is a non-performing matured balloon (status 5; part of dlqRate), a fraction of 1.

ssRate.description: Share of balance with the special servicer (transfer date after any return date), a fraction of 1.

trusts.description: Count of trusts that filed loan-level data for the month.

source.description: Fixed attribution and licence text (CC BY 4.0).

floor.description: Fewest loans a cell needs for its rates to be published (50).

note.description: The rule in words: it applies to byType, byVintage, byState, byTypeVintage and the by-type monthly CSV.

url.description: Address of the distress index page.

view.description: Which view this answer is. Values: default = no view asked: headline, flows and type together; headline = headline, now, nowAll, withLegacy; flows = flows; type = byType, byTypeMonthly; vintage = byVintage, byTypeVintage; state = byState; series = series, backHistory; seasoning = seasoning.

withLegacy.description: The latest month with the older conduit trusts added (issued before late 2016, read from their monthly 10-D reports because they file no ABS-EE).

headline.description: headline plus the older trusts, on the index's records basis.

legacy.description: The older trusts on their own.

now.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.

nowAll.description: Distress rates for one group of loans (a property type, an origination year, a state or a property type in one origination year), on the index month.
